title: Daily lens — Chief Office scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick, portable day lens for the chief office — capture the 3 no-fail priorities, one-line framing for meetings, immediate asks, and two minute notes-to-self. Keep it messy, actionable, and portable (copy into handoff at EOD).

Top 3 priorities (no more):
1) Complete CEO prep for partner call (Thu 10:30 PT) — finalize 2 slides: partnership ask + pilot success metrics. Framing: partnership must reduce inference unit cost by 15% at scale; ask: co-bill and commit to pilot capacity.
2) Approve Dedicated capacity commit memo for Acme (legal + finance redline done) — decision: sign v1 or push to 1-week negotiation? If revenue > $1.2M ARR, approve.
3) Greenlight on canary rollback policy for model rollout (engineering + SRE). Need explicit SLO thresholds and fallback variant mapping.

Weekly goals (quick checkpoints):
- Finish partner slide deck + rehearse with CEO by Wed EOD.
- Lock Dedicated quoting template with finance by Fri.
- Get SRE runbook + canary metrics table into Console -> Rollouts by Thurs.

Time blocks (today):
- 08:30-09:00: personal inbox triage & urgent hooks.
- 09:00-10:15: deep work — partner slide + bullets.
- 10:30-11:00: 1:1 with Leila (status & blockers). Prep: ask about legal outstanding items and timeline.
- 11:15-12:00: Exec sync (30m) + decision time for Acme memo.
- 12:00-13:00: Lunch / buffer.
- 13:00-14:00: SRE walkthrough on canary tests (bring SLO spreadsheet).
- 14:15-15:00: Quick check on GTM pricing questions with Growth.
- 15:30-16:00: CEO rehearsal (run slides, 2-minute pause for difficult Qs).
- 16:30-17:00: Close open follow-ups / handoff notes for tomorrow.

Meeting prep (one-sentence frames + ask):
- Partner call (Thu): frame as "pilot-first"; ask: 3-month pilot, co-funding for dedicated nodes, agreed success metrics. Goal: secure signed LOI for pilot.
- Acme contract review: frame: clear thresholds for throughput & P99 latency; ask: approve template with finance caveat. Goal: sign by next Tue.
- SRE canary run: frame: failure growth pattern & automated fallback; ask: confirm thresholds and who hits manual abort. Goal: merge policy into rollout UI.

Follow-ups / open tickets (quick):
- JIRA-9812: finance redlines on Acme — waiting on tax clause from Finance (Ethan). If not in by Wed, escalate.
- JIRA-10003: canary metric instrumentation — blocked on SDK bump (eng infra).
- Slack thread #exec-ops: confirm who owns partner NDA updates.

Decisions to make today:
- Approve Acme v1? (Approve if revenue threshold met AND no new legal risk) — note: legal flagged IP clause, need Leila signoff.
- Canary SLO thresholds: use current P95 baseline + 20% headroom for short-window, rollback at 3x error rate.

Notes to self (quick heuristics / rehearsals):
- If partner asks for lower unit price, push for trial volume guarantee instead of price cut.
- Rehearse "what goes wrong" answers: pilot missed metrics -> offer extended pilot + success coaching.
- Keep responses crisp: 1-line problem, 1-line proposed fix, 1-line ask.

Quick wins to clear today (5–30m items):
- Send CEO one-pager for partner call (done?) [ ]
- Ping Finance on tax clause (Ethan) [ ]
- Share canary metrics snapshot with SRE before 13:00 [ ]
- Update Exec slate confluence with decision flags (title + TL;DR) [ ]

Risk / escalation list:
- If legal holds Acme longer than 48 hours, ops to prepare fallback template.
- If SDK bump slips, cut manual instrumentation checklist for canary.

Two-minute reflection (end of day paste into handoff):
- What moved? What didn't? Biggest blocker and next action owner.

Random notes / fragments:
- PR comment on GH-PR-1256: confirm telemetry name for "inference.unit_cost".
- Keep list of demo customers who will serve for partner pilot: Acme, NovaHealth, SparkAI.

Tomorrow's preview:
- Final partner rehearsal, full exec readout, status call with Finance.

-- end --
